blocks.text:
think fluid overload
1. daily weight — same time each day
2. fluid balance — strict input/output HEART FAILURE nursing checks red flag: acute pulmonary oedema
3. oedema + breathlessness — watch worsening symptoms
6. position upright if SOB
5. meds — diuretics, monitor U&Es
4. obs — HR, BP, RR, sats
• listen for crackles • ask about orthopnoea
follow local policy / IV glucose or IM glucagon

YES NO Give quick-acting carbs recheck BM in 10-15 min then longer-acting snack if due escalate / call for help follow local policy / IV glucose or IM glucagon recheck BM document + identify cause
